SELECT
  SUM(product_price) AS revenue,
  SUM(supply_cost) AS cost_of_goods,
  SUM(product_price) - SUM(supply_cost) AS gross_profit,
  100.0 * (SUM(product_price) - SUM(supply_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(product_price), 0) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items
WHERE strftime('%Y', ordered_at) = '2025'
